message: I’ve been thinking about how we can make preparedness feel a little less daunting and a bit more like a cozy family project. Gathering supplies for an emergency kit can be a fun way to spend an afternoon together—think of it as a scavenger hunt for essentials! Plus, it gives us peace of mind knowing we’re ready for anything that comes our way. What’s your favorite way to prepare or involve your family in this process? 🤗
